subject: 1966 Ford GT40 Mk II / FAM022 / CLS021

supplierDecision.reason: Ford's Chris Amon account documents event- and car-specific Firestone/Goodyear use at 1966 Le Mans; it does not justify assigning one supplier to a generic 1966 Mk II fixture.

sources.title: Ford GT 40 homologation form 224, Group 4
sources.limitations: Covers the homologated 4.736 L Group 4 GT40, not the 7.0 L Mk II prototype; it is a scope boundary, not exact Mk II tire calibration.

sources.title: Ford GT40 — The American Challenge
supports: provision for 8-inch front and 9.5-inch rear magnesium wheels
sources.limitations: Direct wheel-width evidence; does not provide exact tire dimensions, pressures, temperature or force curves.

sources.title: Remembering Le Mans 1966
supports: Firestone intermediate use on the McLaren/Amon car
sources.limitations: Retrospective first-person event account; supports Le Mans supplier/failure context, not a generic Mk II supplier or numeric pressure/temperature target.

sources.title: Le Mans Progress Meeting No. 11 — 1966 race review
sources.limitations: No direct tire dimensions, pressures or temperatures.

hostSpecification.value: Installed WSC60 Ford GT40 Mk II metadata identifies 1966; imported AC physics mass is 1161 kg.

rimArchitecture.value: Ford documents 8-inch front and 9.5-inch rear wheel provision; imported host uses 15-inch rim diameter and 0.245/0.325 m tire widths.

construction.value: Bias/cross-ply is the internal FAM022 compatibility classification; the focused source set does not expose a direct carcass specification.

supplier.value: General / unknown for this generic fixture; retain Firestone/Goodyear only as 1966 Le Mans event evidence.

compound.value: Dry endurance/race spec; exact period compound code unresolved.

pressure.value: No period Mk II hot/cold pressure guidance found in the focused primary set.

temperature.value: No period tread, carcass or core temperature window found.

durability.value: Ford race records establish endurance completion context; Amon records high-speed intermediate tread shedding, but no numeric wear-life mapping.

wetIntermediate.value: Amon explicitly records Firestone intermediates in damp 1966 Le Mans conditions; exact construction and compound remain unknown.

forbiddenInference: Do not convert FIA dimensional-measurement pressure, modern historic eligibility, or event-specific supplier testimony into a universal historical pressure/supplier value.
